hot_path.name: RunResidentRows
hot_path.source_reads: x and residual are consumed once per row
hot_path.resident_value: FP32 u=x+residual remains in one UB row
hot_path.precision: all math FP32; single RNE cast to native dtype at output

generic_path.name: RunGenericRows
generic_path.coverage: FP16/BF16/FP32 and all legal rows and D
generic_path.precision: same arithmetic chain as hot path

v004_changes.revert_v003: removed AddNativeU native-u quantize and invRms chain; restored V002 arithmetic (FP32 u unquantized, (u/rms)*gamma+bias)
v004_changes.explicit_rne_half: FromFloat<half> uses explicit round-to-nearest-even bit manipulation instead of static_cast (golden CAST_RINT = RNE)
v004_changes.explicit_rne_bf16: FromFloat<bfloat16_t> uses explicit RNE with proper Inf/NaN/sign handling (replaces add-bias trick)
v004_changes.formula: output = (u / rms) * gamma + bias with rms = sqrt(mean(u*u)+eps), all FP32, one RNE cast at output
